# Trackdesk

Trackdesk is an affiliate tracking platform for managing partners, offers, conversions, commissions, billing, and performance reporting.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/trackdesk/.

## Actions

- **Build Tracking Link** (read-only): Generate a Trackdesk tracking URL for one affiliate traffic source and offer.
- **Get Affiliate** (read-only): Return detailed information for one affiliate identified by its Trackdesk account ID.
- **Get Daily Performance Report** (read-only): Return Trackdesk performance rows, newest first, and aggregate totals for an inclusive date range.
- **List Advertisers** (read-only): Return one filtered page of advertisers.
- **List Affiliate Tiers** (read-only): Return all active affiliate tiers with their IDs, names, exact default payout rates, and default-tier flags.
- **List Affiliates** (read-only): Return one filtered page of affiliates, including Trackdesk account and traffic-source identifiers, status, tier, fraud signals, tags, and…
- **List Coupons** (read-only): Return one filtered page of Trackdesk coupons and their advertiser, affiliate traffic-source, offer, code, and status associations.
- **List Offers** (read-only): Return one filtered page of Trackdesk offers with each offer's data, pricing configuration, and landing pages.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Return all Trackdesk tags with their IDs, names, colors, and resource scopes.
